text:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/generate (us-west). 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> 7% in last 3m. Auto paging flagged: kv-prefix cache errors and increased DB paging. Paging threshold: 80%.

devon: paging me :pager: — I'm oncall. Acknowledge and paging incident on-call list.

iris: seeing lots of `prefix_lookup` checksum errors in logs across prefix-shard-12..15:
```
ERR kv/prefix_lookup.go:172 checksum mismatch shard=13 key=0x7f2a3c db_index=42
WARN prefetch/worker.go:88 prefetch failed shard=13 err=corrupt-prefix
```
Most affected requests are short-chat (seq len < 128) — weird.

maria: metrics snapshot (last 5m):
- 5xx rate: 7.1% (gateway)
- p95 latency: 1.2s -> 3.9s
- downstream DB p99 read time: 1.6s (up from 120ms)
- kv-prefix cache hitrate per-shard: shard13=11%, shard14=9%, shards others ~85%

sam: hypothesis: prefix cache bloom-filter update deployed ~30m ago may have regressed stale-key handling -> checksum/false-negatives -> prefetch thrash -> DB paging.

jess: customer impact: some customers reporting timeouts on chat composer and upload endpoints. Support queue shows ~12 tickets with similar stack (502 gateway). Marking P1 severity until mitigated.

devon: plan
1) disable prefix prefetch on shards 12-15 (fast toggle)
2) flip feature flag `kv.prefix_bloom_check=false`
3) apply circuit-breaker on /v1/generate for 10s slowdowns to fail fast and reduce DB load
4) follow up with a read-only rollback of bloom filter rollout

iris: running commands now — disabling prefetch worker group for shard 12-15:
```
# prod oncall runbook
kennelctl annotate prefetch-group shard=12-15 state=disabled --author=iris --reason="live-mitigation"
```

support-bot: Noted customer impact tags updated. Support pages updated with ETA: 30m.

sam: flipping feature flag:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/kv-config KV_PREFIX_BLOOM_CHECK=false
```
Applying... will monitor.

maria: DB read p99 dropped to 420ms after disable. 5xx rate down to 2.4% (5m window). Hitrate on shards 12-15 still low but DB paging reduced.

devon: enabling circuit-breaker rule to reduce tail latency:
```
curl -X POST https://gateway-config/api/routes/v1/generate/circuit -d '{"trips":1,"window_ms":10000}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer XXX'
```

jess: keeping customers updated: sent message to impacted customer list; status page updated: partial degraded service.

iris: digging into root cause: checksum mismatch appears when prefix tombstones were compacted incorrectly by compaction job v2. The compaction job ran as part of bloom-rollout. Found tombstone drift across replicas causing inconsistent prefix index.

sam: good catch. immediate mitigation checklist:
- rollback compaction config
- pause compaction job
- run index-consistency-check on shards 12-15

devon: I paused compaction job and initiated consistency check (long-running). Kicked off `index-check --shards=12-15 --mode=quick`.

maria: quick-check results: 13/15 shards show small index drift; shard13 has 1.2% corrupt entries. We'll need deeper repair offline but that can wait after traffic stabilizes.

support-bot: Customers with active incidents have been emailed. Next update in 15m. :clock3:

jess: handoff note for next oncall (night): mitigation steps performed, DB load reduced, feature flag disabled, compaction paused. Remaining work: repair corrupted index entries and coordinated safe re-enable of prefix prefetch after fix.

devon: tagging eng-sre for postmortem and durable fix. Action items assigned:
- iris: full index-repair playbook for shards 12-15 (priority)
- sam: revert bloom rollout and add stronger integration tests for tombstone compaction
- maria: monitor DB paging and prepare capacity plan if repairs take long
- jess: maintain customer comms and postmortem timeline

iris: quick status: 5xx now 0.9% (down to baseline within 18m of mitigation). Keeping prefetch disabled until index-repair completes.

sam: note for postmortem — consider adding canary traffic to compaction job and a destructive-safety flag to prevent tombstone drift during rollout.

devon: closing immediate pager; leaving incident thread open for handoff notes. Oncall handoff at 5523458400 — next oncall please pick up index-repair and follow-up.

jess: adding incident tag: kv-prefix-index-drift-5523456789. Will request postmortem within 48h.

support-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2. Final customer update will go after postmortem.

-- end of thread --
